'''Leta''' was a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] who joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] around [[3631 BBY]]. Leta became embroiled in an argument with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kaius]], who blamed [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]]&mdash;the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]&mdash;for the state of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Leta, on the other hand, believed that the Emperor was testing the Sith and that everything was part of his ultimate vision for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
